entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand does not support a %s-shaped float operand, which cerberus issue #2333 does not cover
entries.rationale: internal invariant, defensive only: cerberus issue #2333 widened this guard to accept every row shape lower(floatExpr, ...) can actually publish for an operand mixedExpHistogramSetOp already confirmed !isExpHistogramValuedShape -- SampleRowShape, GridWindowRowShape (a matrix rate()/increase() at range-query step) and ReducedWindowRowShape (an instant _over_time reducer) -- so the remaining default arm (HistogramRowShape / MixedRowShape) can only fire if a future histogram-aware float lowering starts publishing one of those shapes for a non-histogram-valued expression, which isExpHistogramValuedShape's own recognizer set does not allow today

guard: default of switch shape over [case chplan.SampleRowShape, chplan.GridWindowRowShape, chplan.ReducedWindowRowShape; default]

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerVectorSetOp's identical check for the float case and lowerExpHistogramSetOp's identical check for the both-histogram case
